thresholdTokens.description: compact when the history reaches this many tokens (a number or e.g. "120k"); default: 80% of the model's context window, leaving room for the reply

trimTokens.description: when the history passes this many tokens (well before compacting), clear old large tool output and keep only the recent part; default "100k", false turns it off

keepTokens.description: after compacting, keep about this many tokens of the most recent messages verbatim; default 30% of the threshold
